description: This file defines a class 'BaselineOptimizer' that manages optimization of baseline test results for layout tests, including reading, writing, and deduplicating baseline data across different directories and platforms.

classes.name: BaselineOptimizer
classes.description: A class responsible for optimizing and managing baseline test results, including deduplication and virtual baseline handling.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Performs optimization of baseline results, including virtual path handling.

methods.name: write_by_directory
methods.description: Outputs baseline results grouped by directory.

methods.name: read_results_by_directory
methods.description: Reads baseline results from filesystem, returning a mapping of directories to result hashes.

methods.name: _optimize_subtree
methods.description: Optimizes baseline results within a subtree for a given baseline name.

methods.name: _move_baselines
methods.description: Moves baseline files on filesystem based on optimization results.

methods.name: _platform
methods.description: Determines platform name from filename based on directory structure.

methods.name: _optimize_virtual_root
methods.description: Removes redundant virtual root baseline if all immediate predecessors have the same result.

methods.name: _baseline_root
methods.description: Returns the root directory for a given baseline, considering virtual suites.

methods.name: _baseline_search_path
methods.description: Returns the search path for baselines for a given port and baseline name.

methods.name: _virtual_suite
methods.description: Looks up virtual suite info for a baseline.

methods.name: _virtual_base
methods.description: Looks up virtual test base for a baseline.

methods.name: _relative_baseline_search_paths
methods.description: Generates ordered list of baseline search paths for a port and baseline.

methods.name: _join_directory
methods.description: Constructs filesystem path for a baseline in a directory, handling virtual suite naming.

methods.name: _results_by_port_name
methods.description: Maps baseline directories to port names based on results.

methods.name: _directories_immediately_preceding_root
methods.description: Memoized method to find directories immediately before the root directory.

methods.name: _optimize_result_for_root
methods.description: Promotes or removes root baseline results based on redundancy.

methods.name: _find_optimal_result_placement
methods.description: Determines optimal placement of baseline results.

methods.name: _remove_redundant_results
methods.description: Removes redundant baseline results across fallback directories.

methods.name: _find_in_fallbackpath
methods.description: Finds a result in a fallback path matching a specific baseline result.
